title: Add or withdraw tests
purpose: Record newly requested analyses or withdraw tests that have not started. Added work keeps its collection-based holding clock and does not rewrite issued reports.
summary: Add tests the client requested later, or withdraw tests that have not started.

tasks.title: Add a test
steps: Choose it in [[Add tests]]. Only active tests for the sample's matrix are offered.
Give the [[Reason]] and select [[Add or withdraw tests]].

tasks.title: Withdraw a test
steps: Tick it under [[Withdraw tests]]. Tests with work started cannot be withdrawn; the page says why.
Give the [[Reason]] and save. At least one test must remain.

good_to_know: A late addition keeps the holding clock that started at collection, so it may already be at risk or expired.
An issued report does not block additions. The new work needs its own review and report; issued versions stay unchanged.
A rejected sample cannot take new tests. Change its disposition first.
Even a cancelled external dispatch keeps its test from being withdrawn.

sections.title: Correction sections
paragraphs: Custodians, project managers and administrators use these sections. A tab marked locked still opens to explain the blocker. The header identifies current client sample ID and client/project.

items.label: Identity, type, location
items.description: Correct client sample ID, sample type, sample source, collector, collection place and sample remarks.

items.label: Collection type and times
items.description: Correct grab/composite and its collection timestamps.

items.label: Receipt observations
items.description: Correct temperature, thermometer, coolant, custody seal, preservation observation or discrepancy.

items.label: Requested tests
items.description: Add tests or withdraw those with no dependent work.

items.label: Matrix
items.description: Correct a wrong matrix and replace its requested tests together. A recorded sample source that does not belong to the new matrix is cleared.

items.label: Requested now
items.description: Lists current analyte, method/version and unit. Tests with dependent work show a cannot be withdrawn explanation.

items.label: Add tests
items.description: Optional multiple selection of active definitions with active methods for this sample matrix, excluding definitions already requested. Search by analyte, method code/version or unit. Labels retain exact version/unit; a native multiple select is the fallback.

items.label: Withdraw tests
items.description: Optional checked selections limited to this sample’s tests that have no analytical result record, external dispatch history, preparation membership or parent-QC dependency for their method. Even a cancelled external dispatch still preserves its test.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required explanation of the client request/withdrawal, at most 4000 characters.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: Choose at least one addition or withdrawal and leave at least one requested test. Each definition can occur once. The service checks the complete remaining set is active and matrix-compatible, not just the additions. Rejected samples cannot take additions; change disposition first. Disposal blocks all changes. An issued report does not block additions: the new work needs its own review/report, and old issued versions remain untouched. Late additions can already be at risk or expired because clocks run from collection. If an option gained work concurrently, removal is refused.

sections.title: Actions and history
paragraphs: Stale sample changes are refused with entered selections retained on the error page; reload and review current requests and history.

items.label: Add or withdraw tests
items.description: Saves requested-test changes with before/after labels and returns to the sample.

items.label: History
items.description: Chronological corrections, including tests changed from not requested or to withdrawn. Prior custody and issued records remain.
